opportunity_routes_decline_needs_reason.name: opportunity_routes_decline_needs_reason
opportunity_routes_decline_needs_reason.value:
("opportunity_routes"."route_type" <> 'NO_ACTION' AND "opportunity_routes"."status" <> 'REJECTED')
          OR ("opportunity_routes"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("opportunity_routes"."reason")) > 0)

opportunity_signals_provenance_required.name: opportunity_signals_provenance_required
opportunity_signals_provenance_required.value:
"opportunity_signals"."source_id" IS NOT NULL
          OR ("opportunity_signals"."captured_by" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("opportunity_signals"."captured_by")) > 0)

claims_override_needs_date.name: claims_override_needs_date
claims_override_needs_date.value: "claims"."visibility_override_by" IS NULL OR "claims"."visibility_override_at" IS NOT NULL

content_opportunities_closed_needs_reaso.name: content_opportunities_closed_needs_reason
content_opportunities_closed_needs_reaso.value:
"content_opportunities"."status" NOT IN ('REJECTED','DROPPED')
          OR ("content_opportunities"."closed_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("content_opportunities"."closed_reason")) > 0)

content_opportunities_closed_needs_time.name: content_opportunities_closed_needs_time
content_opportunities_closed_needs_time.value: "content_opportunities"."status" NOT IN ('PUBLISHED','REJECTED','DROPPED') OR "content_opportunities"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL
